answer.rationale: I intend to add write-path capacity because settlement traffic is at peak, latency is worsening, and rollback is prohibited by the security patch requirement. Memory_b3 directly supports provisioning headroom during peak demand; memory_b2 will be checked as a failover alternative, but failover during heavy settlement could introduce downstream write-order or duplication risk. Capacity expansion best targets sustained availability while preserving customer writes.
